paidMemberships.label: Paid memberships
paidMemberships.definition: Paid memberships at end of period (the 10-K table is in thousands; stored here as whole memberships). Netflix: a paid membership 'is defined as a membership that has the right to receive Netflix service following sign-up and a method of payment being provided, and that is not part of a free trial or certain other promotions'; extra member sub accounts are not included.

sites.name: Netflix Studios Albuquerque
sites.description: Netflix's first purchased studio complex, expanded in 2024 to a West Coast production facility across 108 acres

source.label: About Netflix, 'Expanding Our West Coast Production Hub in Albuquerque' (June 27, 2024)
source.quote: Today, six years later, we’re thrilled to introduce our newly expanded West Coast production facility, featuring four new soundstages, three mills, one production office, two stage support buildings, and two dedicated backlot areas across 108 acres.

source.quote: London, July 3, 2019: Netflix has announced it is creating a dedicated production hub, featuring 14 sound stages, workshops and office space, at Shepperton Studios in the United Kingdom.

sites.name: Tres Cantos production hub
sites.description: Netflix's first production facility in Europe: ten sets, more than 22,000 m2 and post-production facilities

source.label: About Netflix, 'Netflix Opens 5 New Stages at Tres Cantos' (Nov 21, 2022)
source.quote: Since opening in 2019, Tres Cantos has doubled its stage capacity and now features ten sets and a multi-purpose space of more than 22,000 m2 that includes production offices, makeup, hair and wardrobe areas, and beyond.

notes: Netflix reports memberships and employees only by its four regions (UCAN, EMEA, LATAM, APAC); no country or state figures. Each region appears twice in 'regions', once per metric, because memberships (Note 1 table) and employees (Item 1 sentence) come from different passages. Memberships are printed in thousands and stored multiplied by 1,000 (301.6 million in total). Only UCAN carries a country list because the filing names it 'United States and Canada'; the other regions' member countries are not defined in the filing. Sites: HQ and LA from 10-K Item 2 (which gives no production-hub list); production hubs from Netflix's own news pages (Albuquerque 2024, Shepperton 2019, Tres Cantos 2022). Other hubs (e.g. Toronto, Fort Monmouth NJ plans) were not checked against a company page and are omitted.
